label: Nebulae
description: A separately loaded, hand-curated overlay of nearby nebulae rendered as approximate 3D volumes.

sources.name: Kounkel et al. (2017); VLBA distance to the Orion Nebula Cluster
O'Dell (2001); structure of the Orion Nebula
Alfonso & García-Varela (2023); Gaia astrometric distance to the Pleiades
Gibson & Nordsieck (2003); Pleiades reflection nebula scattering geometry

cutoffPolicy: Hand-picked showcase nebulae, not a complete census. Centers use catalogued positions and adopted literature distances; volumes are illustrative models constrained by angular size and published geometry.
